question: ________, a tribal dancer from the Baiga community, received the Padma Shri Award in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arjun Singh Dhurve**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arjun Singh Dhurve** is a tribal dancer from the Baiga community.
 
• He was honored with the **Padma Shri Award** in the year 2022.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India, which recognizes distinguished contributions in various fields including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Arjun Singh Dhurve's recognition highlights the cultural richness and heritage of the Baiga community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Baiga community** is one of the prominent tribal communities in India, primarily residing in the central Indian states of Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Jharkhand.
 
• The Baiga people are known for their unique cultural practices, traditional knowledge, and their deep connection with nature.
 
• The Padma Awards, instituted in 1954, are announced every year on the occasion of Republic Day.
 
• The awards are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan (for exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (for distinguished service of higher order), and Padma Shri (for distinguished service).
